data.description: At 16th level, fey eidolons gain the ability to use either blindness/deafness, detect thoughts, glitterdust, hideous laughter, invisibility (self only), minor image, mirror image, or tongues as a spell-like ability three times per day. They also can select an additional spell-like ability from the 1st-level list or the 8th-level list.
data.name: Eidolon Progession Lv.16
